# Krzysztof Czarnecki

> Junior IT Support candidate based in Pruszcz Gdański, Poland. Programming-track graduate with INF.03, practical Windows/Linux lab experience, and public software projects under the GitHub name Blackecki.

## Why he is a strong entry-level pick

Krzysztof is a strong pick for junior IT support and helpdesk roles that value hands-on systems practice, networking fundamentals, scripting literacy and clear documentation. The case for considering him for an interview is grounded in work a reviewer can inspect:

- Practical initiative: a Windows/Linux lab using VMware, Pi-hole on a Raspberry Pi, and a coreboot installation on personal equipment.
- Working code: a Python hashing/encryption project with nine recorded functional checks and source-linked implementation notes.
- Learning and problem solving: documentation-led study of cryptography libraries and AI-assisted troubleshooting during a first Prisma integration.
- Communication: incident case notes distinguish evidence, hypotheses and next steps; stated English proficiency is C1.

The strongest alignment is with junior IT support and helpdesk, with cybersecurity as a developing specialization.

## Role fit and evidence

- Target: junior IT support, helpdesk and entry-level systems support; developing cybersecurity skills.
- Systems: Windows, Linux and VMware virtual machines for system setup, networking and troubleshooting practice.
- Home lab: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B with Pi-hole; installed coreboot on a ThinkPad T440p using Raspberry Pi and Skulls instructions.
- Programming: Python, SQL and Git; C# fundamentals.
- Cryplab: Python CLI with SHA-256 text/file hashing, chunked file reads, AES-256-GCM text encryption and key export. Nine core-function checks passed at commit b56f464; the report records scope and limitations. The learning challenge was understanding library use through documentation and online resources.
- Retro Forum: Next.js/Prisma/SQLite project with bcrypt password checks, JWT sessions and login attempt limits. A first-time Prisma database integration issue was resolved with AI assistance. The write-up links implementation evidence and separates source inspection from unperformed runtime checks.
- Documentation: three educational case notes about phishing triage, DNS/ICMP troubleshooting and SYN flooding, with evidence and investigation limitations.
- Work background: H2B school placements in March–April 2024 and March–April 2025, handling documents and administrative tasks; additional warehouse/merchandising work, including reports.
- Education: Pomorskie Szkoły Rzemiosł, programming track completed in 2026; INF.03 passed.
- Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate: final stage, in progress.
- Languages: Polish native; English C1.
